title: 第62章九品炼脏圆满第61章内应魏合
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 按照魏合的要求，自己要做的就是在他通知自己的时候，制造雷云县的混乱。
如此一来的话，魏合就能够搅动雷云县的风云。
整个雷云县，就是一个即将被点燃的火药桶，而他，恰好就坐在这火药桶的正中心。
“要不要将这些信息说出去？”
陈安的手指轻轻的敲击在桌面上，发出清脆的声响。
只是这个念头，刚刚在陈安的心头浮现的时候，就被陈安直接压制下去了。
或许将信息说出去，能够影响到魏合的计划，但是以魏合这个人的心狠手辣来说……
对方真的相信自己是鬼师了么？
亦或者说……他真的相信鬼师么？
陈安的内心，只有一片冰冷的清明。
魏合能够将黑风镖局变成现如今的雷云县三大势力之一，绝对不是简单的人物。
而对于陈安而言，六十年的蹉跎岁月，早已让他看透了一个真理。
将希望寄托于他人，是世间最愚蠢之事。
求人，不如求己！
唯一的生路，就是在风暴席卷一切之前，拥有掀翻这张棋盘的力量！
他必须突破！
从九品炼脏，迈入八品锻骨！
不仅如此，鬼师那部《百鬼夜行阵》的阵道传承，将是他另一张至关重要的底牌。
陈安的目光，落在了自己所有的家当上。
从秃鹫帮库房和鬼师身上搜刮来的黄金、丹药，堆在一起，足以让任何一个九品武者眼红疯狂。
但是想要从炼脏突破到锻骨，却也不是那么容易的事情。
炼骨如换骨，那是一场生命层次的蜕变，每一步，都需要海量精纯能量的支撑。
“不够，还远远不够！”
陈安做出了决定。
次日，天色微明。
他体内的骨骼发出一阵细密的爆鸣，身形在微调中拔高，面部轮廓变得硬朗，眼中的浑浊被一股精悍之气取代。
他以采买个人用品为由，向镖局的管事告了假，轻车熟路地离开了风云镖局。
街道上的气氛，比上次更加压抑。
巡逻的衙役数量翻了一倍，往来行人的脸上，都带着一丝挥之不去的惶恐。
城门口甚至搭建了临时的关卡，对所有进出人员的盘查，几乎要将人祖上三代都问个遍。
很显然，正如昨夜的时候，魏合所说的那般。
雷云县令似乎也察觉到了一些不对劲儿。
山雨欲来风满楼。
陈安对此视若无睹，径直走进了珍宝楼。
还是那个机灵的小厮，当他看到陈安面无表情地将一袋袋黄金倒在柜台上时，眼珠子都快瞪了出来。
“所有能辅助冲击八品炼骨的丹药，药材，我全要了。”
陈安的声音平静，却带着不容置疑的决断。
小厮被这股豪气震慑，不敢有丝毫怠慢，手脚麻利地将楼内所有符合要求的珍品，尽数打包。
陈安面不改色地将从秃鹫帮缴获的大半财宝挥霍一空，换来了十几只入手沉甸甸的玉瓶。
满载而归。
当他悄然返回小院时，恰逢秦婉儿提着食盒前来。
“陈爷爷，您的脸色……”
“咳咳，旧疾复发，不碍事。”陈安摆了摆手，“接下来一段时日，老头子需要静养，你便不必过来了。桩功不可懈怠，每日两个时辰，缺一不可。”
秦婉儿见他面色凝重，眼中虽有疑虑，却也不敢多问，只能担忧地应下，一步三回头地离去。
content_en:
According to Wei He's request, what he had to do was to create chaos in Leiyun County when he informed him.
In this way, Wei He can stir up the situation in Leiyun County.
The entire Leiyun County was a powder keg about to be ignited, and he happened to be sitting in the center of the powder keg.
"Do you want to tell this information?"
Chen An's fingers tapped lightly on the table, making a crisp sound.
Just when this idea appeared in Chen An's mind, he was directly suppressed by Chen An.
Maybe telling the information could affect Wei He's plan, but considering Wei He's ruthlessness...
Does the other party really believe that he is a ghost master?
Or...does he really believe in ghost masters?
In Chen An's heart, there was only a cold clarity.
Wei He was able to turn the Black Wind Escort Bureau into one of the three major forces in Leiyun County today. He was definitely not a simple figure.
For Chen An, sixty years of wasted years have already allowed him to see through a truth.
Placing your hopes on others is the stupidest thing in the world.
It is better to seek help from others than from yourself!
The only way to survive is to have the power to overturn this chessboard before the storm sweeps everything away!
He must break through!
From the ninth level of viscera refining to the eighth level of bone refining!
Not only that, the formation inheritance of the Ghost Master's "Hundred Ghosts Night Parade" will be another crucial trump card for him.
Chen An's eyes fell on all his belongings.
The piles of gold and elixirs plundered from the Vulture Gang's warehouse and ghost masters were enough to make any ninth-grade warrior jealous and crazy.
But it is not that easy to break through from refining the organs to forging the bones.
Refining bones is like replacing bones. It is a transformation of life levels. Every step requires the support of massive amounts of pure energy.
"Not enough, far from enough!"
Chen An made a decision.
The next day, the sky was dim.
The bones in his body let out a fine explosion, his figure lifted up with fine adjustments, his facial contours became tougher, and the turbidity in his eyes was replaced by a powerful aura.
He took a leave of absence from the escort agency on the pretext of purchasing personal items, and left Fengyun Escort Agency in a familiar way.
The atmosphere on the street was even more depressing than last time.
The number of patrolling government officials has doubled, and there is a trace of lingering fear on the faces of passers-by.
A temporary checkpoint was even set up at the gate of the city, and all people entering and exiting were interrogated, almost to the extent that three generations of our ancestors were questioned.
Obviously, just like what Wei He said last night.
Magistrate Leiyun also seemed to notice something was wrong.
The storm is about to come and the wind is filling the building.
Chen An turned a blind eye to this and walked straight into the Zhenbao Building.
He was still the clever boy. When he saw Chen An emptying bags of gold on the counter with an expressionless expression, his eyes almost popped out of his head.
"I want all the elixirs and medicinal materials that can assist in the eighth-grade bone refining."
Chen An's voice was calm, but filled with unquestionable determination.
The young man was shocked by this arrogance and did not dare to neglect at all. He quickly packed up all the treasures in the building that met the requirements.
Chen An, with a straight face, squandered most of the treasure seized from the Vulture Gang and exchanged it for a dozen heavy jade bottles.
Returned with a full load.
When he quietly returned to the courtyard, Qin Wan'er came with a food box.
"Grandpa Chen, your face..."
"Ahem, the old illness has recurred, it's not a problem." Chen An waved his hand, "In the next period of time, the old man needs to rest, so you don't need to come over. Don't slack off on your work, two hours a day, both are indispensable."
Qin Wan'er saw his solemn expression and although there were doubts in his eyes, she didn't dare to ask any more questions. She could only agree with worry and leave with three turns.
title_en: Chapter 62: The Ninth Grade Zang Refining is Completed Chapter 61: Internal Response to Wei He
